captions.detailed: A compact, matte-black home-video camcorder with a rectangular main body, a front-facing objective lens barrel, a top-mounted viewfinder, and a side-mounted display screen. The side display door rotates outward on a vertical hinge, the rear eyepiece diopter wheel rotates on a small transverse shaft, and the front focus ring rotates continuously around the lens barrel.
captions.instruction: Generate a compact home-video camcorder with a dark matte finish. The model must feature a main body, a front cylindrical lens with a rotatable focus ring, a rotatable side display door, and a viewfinder with a rotatable diopter wheel.
captions.factory: The code constructs a main chassis using a box primitive and adds a top viewfinder block. The lens assembly is created from concentric cylinders, including a separate focus ring cylinder. The diopter wheel and side display screen are modeled as thin cylinder and box shapes, respectively, and are attached to the main body using revolute and continuous joint articulations.
